findings.title: ANCHOR_PATTERN matches any tag starting with 'a' and is case-sensitive
findings.body: `ANCHOR_PATTERN` is defined as `Pattern.compile("</?a[^>]*>")`. Because `a` is not followed by a word boundary or whitespace check, this regex matches any HTML tag whose name begins with `a` (such as `<applet>`, `<audio>`, `<area>`, `<aside>`, `<article>`, or `<abbr>`) and strips it in `santizeAnchors` if the English string happens to contain the same tag. More importantly, it is case-sensitive and requires `a` to be immediately after `<` or `</`, so a translation containing `<A href="javascript:alert(1)">` or `<a/href=...>` or an unclosed `<a href=...` will not be matched by `ANCHOR_PATTERN`, and `santizeAnchors` will not report an anchor mismatch (though OWASP sanitizer may strip it later, the specific anchor validation is bypassed or produces confusing errors). Additionally, in `santizeAnchors`, if the English message has `<a href="...">` and the translation omits the anchor tag completely, the `while (matcher.find())` loop does not execute at all, silently allowing translations that drop links.

findings.title: Unescaping HTML4 entities on both input and sanitized output allows entity-encoded XSS payloads to pass verification
findings.body: `normalizeValue` calls `StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4(value)` before sanitization (line 130), and `verifySafeHtml` calls `StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4(sanitized)` after sanitization (line 95) before comparing `sanitized` with `value`. If a `.properties` file contains HTML-escaped dangerous markup such as `<script>alert(1)</script>` or `<img src=x onerror=alert(1)>`, `normalizeValue` unescapes it into raw `<script>...</script>`, the OWASP sanitizer strips the disallowed tag, and the check catches it. However, if a translation contains plain text that OWASP sanitizer escapes into HTML entities (for example `<` or `&` or quotes inside attributes), unescaping `sanitized` turns `<script>` back into `<script>`. Specifically, if a translation has double-escaped entities like `&lt;script&gt;`, `normalizeValue` unescapes it once to `<script>`, OWASP sanitizer leaves `<script>` intact (or normalizes it), and then line 95 unescapes `sanitized` a second time to `<script>`, causing a false mismatch or, conversely, if `value` had `<1>` (which OWASP escapes to `<1>`), line 95 unescapes it back to `<1>`. Any tag that OWASP sanitizer *neutralizes by entity-encoding* rather than stripping (for example, unrecognized numeric/custom tags or text following `<`) is unescaped back to its raw `<...>` form on line 95 and thus equals `value`, bypassing the sanitizer check completely.

findings.title: Substring index out of bounds when value and sanitized share both a prefix and a suffix
findings.body: When computing the diff snippet for the error message (lines 102-111), `start` is incremented from the front and `end` is incremented from the back independently without ensuring `start + end <= Math.min(value.length(), sanitized.length())`. If `value` and `sanitized` have overlapping matching prefixes and suffixes (for example, `value` is `"<b><b>"` and `sanitized` is `"<b>"`, where `start` reaches 3 and `end` reaches 3), `sanitized.length() - end` becomes `0`, which is less than `start` (`3`), causing `sanitized.substring(start, sanitized.length() - end)` on line 111 to throw `StringIndexOutOfBoundsException`.

findings.title: i18next message in account-ui and admin-ui replaced with Java MessageFormat / ChoiceFormat syntax
findings.body: In `js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 188) and `js/apps/admin-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v2/admin/messages/messages_en.properties` (line 3138), `error-invalid-multivalued-size` was changed from `Attribute {{0}} must have at least {{1}} and at most {{2}} value(s).` to `Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.`. Unlike the FreeMarker-based login/admin themes which use Java's `MessageFormat`, `account-ui` (v3) and `admin-ui` (v2) are React applications using `i18next`, where interpolation placeholders use double curly braces (`{{0}}`, `{{1}}`, `{{2}}`) and Java `ChoiceFormat` syntax (`{2,choice,...}`) is not supported. Changing this breaks parameter interpolation and renders literal `{0}`, `{1}`, `{2,choice,...}` in the UI.

findings.title: Lithuanian translation replaced with Italian text in account and login messages
findings.body: In `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 101, `totpStep1`) and `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties` (line 71, `loginTotpStep1`), the Lithuanian text was replaced with Italian: `Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:`.

findings.title: Simplified Chinese message file updated with Traditional Chinese text
findings.body: In `themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_zh_CN.properties` (line 112), `totpStep1` was replaced with Traditional Chinese (`在您的手機上安裝以下應用程式之一：`) instead of Simplified Chinese (as used in the rest of `messages_zh_CN.properties`, e.g., `在您的移动设备中安装以下任意一个应用：`).
